description: Updates a notebook instance. NotebookInstance updates include upgrading or downgrading the ML compute instance used for your notebook instance to accommodate changes in your workload requirements.

researchLinks.description: Execute Commands on SageMaker Notebook Instance via Lifecycle Configuration
Privilege escalation with SageMaker and there's more hiding in execution roles

securityImplications: Attackers might use UpdateNotebookInstance to attach a malicious lifecycle configuration to a stopped notebook instance, so their code runs under the notebook's IAM execution role when it restarts, escalating their privileges.
